dialogue-before-starting-tree-gnome-vill.npc: I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here? If we can't hold back Khazard's men we're all doomed.

after-returning-the-orb-of-protection-to.npc: I'm ok, this battle is going to take longer to win than I expected. The Khazard troops won't give up even without the orb.
